''See also: [[Divine Titans Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|Divine [[Titans]] are powerful, massive combat machines that serve as essential tools for fighting threats such as the [[D’Niss|D'Niss]]. These masterpieces of engineering are designed to amplify a pilot's existing abilities, though they function differently than [[Zenith Devices]] as they lack adaptive systems. Summoning a [[Titan]] requires a specific spoken incantation, which can be shortened through intense concentration, though using the full phrase demands total focus from the user. While they are formidable weapons, they can be dangerous to operate; for example, a [[Titan]] may become difficult to control or enter a rampage if the pilot is overwhelmed. One specific unit has been compromised by [[solar dragon]] blood, causing it to emit extreme heat and making its control even more volatile. Various colors of [[Titans]] exist, including red, green, blue, white, and orange models, each possessing unique characteristics such as integrated weaponry or specialized energy outputs. They are often deployed by skilled combatants like [[Titan Knights]] to protect innocent populations and serve as a primary defense for the [[Galactic Union]].}}

{{spoiler|book=lh-03-the-knight|[[Doctor Janbell Cryce]] is the inventor who designed and built the Divine [[Titans]].<ref name="lh-03-the-knight-c2">''The Knight'', chapter 2</ref><ref name="lh-03-the-knight-c10">''The Knight'', chapter 10</ref> These powerful entities are piloted by combatants and possess the ability to convey [[Combat Arts]].<ref name="lh-03-the-knight-c12">''The Knight'', chapter 12</ref><ref name="lh-03-the-knight-c39">''The Knight'', chapter 39</ref> There are five Divine [[Titans]] in total, all of which function as entities that can be summoned.<ref name="lh-03-the-knight-c20">''The Knight'', chapter 20</ref><ref name="lh-03-the-knight-c31">''The Knight'', chapter 31</ref> Despite their strength, the Divine [[Titans]] operate with a limited energy capacity.<ref name="lh-03-the-knight-c42">''The Knight'', chapter 42</ref>}}

{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|Two Divine [[Titans]] emerged to provide support for the [[The Zenith Starship|Zenith Starship]].<ref name="lh-04-the-pilot-c26">''The Pilot'', chapter 26</ref> In the distance, red and green Divine [[Titans]] can be seen engaged in combat.<ref name="lh-04-the-pilot-c29">''The Pilot'', chapter 29</ref> These units are typically kept within a hangar.<ref name="lh-04-the-pilot-c32">''The Pilot'', chapter 32</ref>}}
